notes: Answered strictly from public biography (b. 21 Dec 1977, Amiens; eldest of three children of two doctors, Francoise Nogues and Jean-Michel Macron; siblings Laurent b.1979 and Estelle b.1982, both went into medicine). A8/A34 use 'no'/'never' on the strength of an unusually well-covered public life turning up no reported near-death childhood event or institutional confinement, not on direct confirmation. A24-A29: married once (2007) to Brigitte Trogneux (formerly his teacher, senior to him); no biological children are documented — Brigitte's three children and grandchildren are from her first marriage — so A28 is 'none' and A29 'na' rather than any inferred fertility difficulty. A30/B1: character composite (outspoken, bold, sociable, practical, philosophical; B1=opt2 reserved/calculating/patient/practical-before-philosophical) reflects the frequently reported contrast between his private reserve/strategic patience and his public directness. Part C answers where no direct evidence exists (C7 marriage money, C8 father, C9 own business, C11 confinement) are marked with low confidence (2) rather than omitted, per the forced-choice format.
